title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 5.2 Solving Systems of Equations by Substitution: Solve a system of equations by substitution
summary: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 5.2 Solving Systems of Equations by Substitution: Solve a system of equations by substitution
body: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, section "5.2 Solving Systems of Equations by Substitution", prints these objectives: "Solve a system of equations by substitution" "Solve applications of systems of equations by substitution". The section text says: "Solving systems of linear equations by graphing is a good way to visualize the types of solutions that may result. However, there are many cases where solving a system by graphing is inconvenient or imprecise. If the graphs extend beyond the small grid with x and y both between −10 and 10, graphing the lines may be cumbersome. And if the solutions to the system are not integers, it can be hard to read their values precisely from a graph." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
